listing.name: Knack — knack_pc (AbdelmoumenDeghbouche)
listing.summary: Upstream reports first chapters playable through fights, story videos, music and saves at up to 120 FPS on Windows; later chapters and Linux gameplay untested. Dust edges, startup text glitches and possible longer-run memory growth remain. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Own decrypted CUSA00068 base and 01.10 update, either merged per upstream profile or selected as separate game/update folders. PKG extraction scripts accept the player own dumped base/update packages.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: README declares v0.1.0 knack-windows.zip with Knack.exe and knack-x86_64.AppImage. Select game and optional separate update folder, then Play. Source uses MSYS2 CLANG64 and Python on Windows or the Linux packaging scripts; first launch prepares shaders.

warnings: Upstream reports first chapters playable through fights, story videos, music and saves at up to 120 FPS on Windows; later chapters and Linux gameplay untested. Dust edges, startup text glitches and possible longer-run memory growth remain.
